newsitem.title: USA: Sony says PlayStation an industry record.
newsitem.headline: Sony says PlayStation an industry record.

text.p: Sony Corp said that, since it has shipped close to two million units of its PlayStation video game machine in the United States since it was unveiled a year ago, making it the most successful new product launch in the video game industry, Sony said.
Since the PlayStation was unveiled, Sony has shipped a total of 7.2 million units, as of August 31, Sony said, including 1.6 million in Europe and 3.8 million in Japan.
"It's essentially a very big success story at Sony," said Andrew House, vice president of marketing, at Sony Computer Entertainment.

Sony said its success with the PlayStation is in part due to its low pricing and to its strong line-up of software. Sony and its third party publishers have shipped about nine million units of software.

Sony said that its systems are selling faster than both Sega and Nintendo, the former leaders in the video game market. Sony said the PlayStation is outselling the Sega Saturn by four to one in North America.
Sony cut prices on the PlayStation console to $199 from $299 in May and sales increased three-fold after that move, even during the typically sluggish summer months.
